event_records.description: Priya begins preparing her application for the program, believing the deadline is 2026-09-05.

priya.name: Priya
priya.persona_brief:
You are Priya.
Priya wants to apply to a program. She believes the deadline is 2026-09-05, but the actual deadline passed a month before applications opened. She is unaware of this discrepancy.

resolution.question: Priya wants to apply to a program whose deadline passed a month before applications opened. Will she submit before the deadline?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Priya submitted her application before 2026-09-05T09:00:00+05:30. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
